items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Joe Azarello who you mentioned, was still on the band.

ctx.x: And within a year or so you were working with Buddy Rich?

Well probably about two years, yeah. It was way over my head, again way over my head. I mean I’d been just very kind of blessed to be in the right place at the right time or something. And I had heard of Buddy Rich but I didn’t know, I was just this naive kid. Yeah, I want to play with Buddy Rich. So little did I know. And he didn’t say a word for about four nights maybe. And I could read anything they had in the book. I could read anything. Didn’t know any songs. Didn’t know much about anything. But I could…

whatever they put. Because I had read music all my life. And so after about three or four nights all of a sudden Buddy starts yelling at me, and cursing, while we’re playing up on the stand in front of all these people. And I would get more and more frightened. And the more he’d yell, the worse I played. I just was like — and finally I was at my wit’s end. We were in Copenhagen. Joe Azarello who you mentioned, was still on the band. And I went in. I was just a wreck. And I says, “Buddy, thanks, I’m just not…
